results.title: Propranolol and Pembrolizumab in Advanced Soft Tissue Sarcoma Patients
results.summary: The goal of this phase 2 clinical trial is to test efficacy and tolerability of combining propranolol and pembrolizumab in patients with advanced angiosarcoma or undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma.
results.official_title: An Open Label Phase 2 Study on Propranolol and Pembrolizumab in Advanced Angiosarcoma and Undifferentiated Pleomorphic Sarcoma - a Scandinavian Sarcoma Group Collaboration

_note: Real run of 2026-10-23 (2,208 studies matched); one of the two studies is kept, its summary cut after the first sentence. The lead sponsor is an individual investigator, so the name is shortened to first name and last initial.
